provenance_notes: Produced by hand, not by eval/runners/candidate.sh: that runner hardcodes /reviso:review and cannot invoke the audit tier. Making it able to is the measure-the-audit-tier change; this run is the baseline that change records.
The tier, case, and SHA fields were written by hand rather than emitted by a runner. Treat them as an assertion about how the run was made, not as machine-recorded identity.
Clean context was preserved as candidate.sh does it: --setting-sources project,local, so no user-level CLAUDE.md, memory, or installed plugins participated.

The reviewed worktree was a detached checkout of head_sha from this repository's own object store, which also contains commits made after head_sha. The run's report flags that its history and prior-reviews lenses reached them; those lenses' candidate counts here are inflated and must not be read as recall.

Two of thirteen verifier agents reported permission denied reading confidence-rubric.md and false-positives.md at the plugin root and scored without them. One recovered only because the repository under review is Reviso and carries its own copies.

CLI 2.1.232 is outside the 2.1.219-2.1.223 range fingerprinted in eval/reference/builtin-skill-notes.md. No upstream baseline was invoked here, so that does not affect this run, but a parity re-baseline is outstanding.
